description: This file defines the BuildSettings class and related components for managing build configurations in a build system, including paths, version requirements, and callbacks.

classes.name: BuildSettings
classes.description: Class encapsulating build configuration settings such as paths, version requirements, and callbacks.

methods.name: SetRootPath
methods.description: Sets the absolute path of the source root.

methods.name: SetPythonPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the Python executable.

methods.name: set_arg_file_template_path
methods.description: Sets the argument file template path.

methods.name: build_args
methods.description: Returns a reference to the build arguments.

methods.name: GetFullPath
methods.description: Returns the full absolute path for a given source file or directory.

methods.name: GetFullPathSecondary
methods.description: Returns the absolute path inside the secondary source path.

methods.name: ItemDefined
methods.description: Called when an item is defined from a background thread.

methods.name: swap_print_callback
methods.description: Swaps the current print callback with a new one.
